name: 01-overview
headline: See what fills your Mac
detail: Your available space, storage goal, and mapped folders in one view.

name: 02-disk-map
headline: Find what takes up space
detail: Choose a folder, then follow the map to its largest files.

name: 03-cache-review
headline: Review before you move
detail: Inspect eligible npm downloads before approving a move to Trash.

name: 04-developer
headline: See what your projects use
detail: Trace build resources and toolchains back to the projects that use them.

name: 05-memory
headline: Keep memory in view
detail: See current memory pressure and follow it over time.

name: 06-monitor
headline: Check in from the menu bar
detail: Glance at available space and memory pressure while you work.

name: 07-ai-tools
headline: See where AI tools put their files
detail: Identify caches, session history, worktrees, and local models before deciding what to keep.
